pairs: Et factum est in diebus Achaz,
And it happened in the days of Ahaz,
the king of Judah, that Rezin,
the king of Syria, and Pekah,
in Jerusalem, ad præliandum contra eam:
ascended to Jerusalem to battle against it.
But they were not able to defeat it.
debellare eam. Et nuntiaverunt domui David,
And they reported to the house of David, saying:
“Syria has withdrawn to Ephraim.” And his heart was shaken,
with the heart of his people,
et cor populi ejus, sicut moventur ligna silvarum a facie venti.
just as the trees of the forest are moved by the face of the wind.
And the Lord said to Isaiah:
Go out to meet Ahaz, you and your son, Jashub,
tu et qui derelictus est Jasub, filius tuus,
who was left behind, to the end of the aqueduct,
ad extremum aquæductus piscinæ superioris in via agri Fullonis;
at the upper pool, on the road to the fuller’s field.
And you shall say to him:
“See to it that you are silent.
et cor tuum ne formidet a duabus caudis titionum fumigantium istorum,
And have no dread in your heart over the two tails of these firebrands, nearly extinguished,
in ira furoris Rasin, regis Syriæ,
which are the wrath of the fury of Rezin, king of Syria,
and of the son of Remaliah.”
eo quod consilium inierit contra te Syria in malum,
For Syria has undertaken a plan against you,
and tear it away for ourselves,
et ponamus regem in medio ejus filium Tabeel.
and appoint the son of Tabeel as a king in its midst.”
For the head of Syria is Damascus,
and the head of Damascus is Rezin;
et adhuc sexaginta et quinque anni,
and within sixty-five years from now,
Ephraim will cease to be a people.
For the head of Ephraim is Samaria,
and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah.
Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad Achaz,
And the Lord spoke further to Ahaz,
Pete tibi signum a Domino Deo tuo,
Ask for a sign for yourself from the Lord your God,
for I will not tempt the Lord.”
Numquid parum vobis est molestos esse hominibus,
Is it such a small thing for you to trouble men,
quia molesti estis et Deo meo?
that you must also trouble my God?
Propter hoc dabit Dominus ipse vobis signum:
For this reason, the Lord himself will grant to you a sign.
et pariet filium, et vocabitur nomen ejus Emmanuel.
and she will give birth to a son, and his name will be called Immanuel.
He will eat butter and honey,
ut sciat reprobare malum, et eligere bonum.
so that he may know to reject evil and to choose good.
Quia antequam sciat puer reprobare malum et eligere bonum,
But even before the boy knows to refuse evil and to choose good,
derelinquetur terra quam tu detestaris a facie duorum regum suorum.
the land that you detest will be abandoned by the face of her two kings.
The Lord will lead over you,
and over the house of your father,
dies qui non venerunt a diebus separationis Ephraim a Juda, cum rege Assyriorum.
such days as have not occurred since the days of the separation of Ephraim from Judah by the king of the Assyrians.
And this shall be in that day:
sibilabit Dominus muscæ quæ est in extremo fluminum Ægypti,
the Lord will call for the fly, which is in the most distant parts of the rivers of Egypt,
et api quæ est in terra Assur;
and for the swarm, which is in the land of Assur.
et requiescent omnes in torrentibus vallium,
and they all will rest in the torrents of the valleys,
and in the caverns of the rocks,
In die illa radet Dominus in novacula conducta in his qui trans flumen sunt,
the Lord will shave with a razor the ones hired by those who are across the river,
by the king of the Assyrians,
from the head to the hairs of the feet,
And this shall be in that day:
a man will raise a cow among oxen,
et præ ubertate lactis comedet butyrum;
and, instead of an abundance of milk, he will eat butter.
butyrum enim et mel manducabit omnis qui relictus fuerit in medio terræ.
For all who are left behind in the midst of the land will eat butter and honey.
And this shall be in that day:
omnis locus ubi fuerint mille vites,
where there were a thousand grapevines worth a thousand pieces of silver,
in spinas et in vepres erunt.
Cum sagittis et arcu ingredientur illuc:
They will enter such places with arrows and bows.
vepres enim et spinæ erunt in universa terra.
For briers and thorns will be throughout the entire land.
Et omnes montes qui in sarculo sarrientur,
But as for all the mountains,
which will be dug with a hoe,
the terror of thorns and briers will not approach those places.
And there will be pasture land for oxen,
